def solution():
    from datetime import datetime

    # Define variables name and value
    grant_date = datetime.strptime("2021-01-15", "%Y-%m-%d")
    exercise_date = datetime.strptime("2022-02-20", "%Y-%m-%d")
    sale_date = datetime.strptime("2023-05-05", "%Y-%m-%d")

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    held_after_exercise = (sale_date - exercise_date).days > 365
    held_after_grant = (sale_date - grant_date).days > 730
    answer = held_after_exercise and held_after_grant

    # return answer
    return answer
